subject: The 2AM message she still remembers
preview_text: Most users skip this feature. The ones who don't get a different kind of girlfriend.
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when you send a text at 2AM, half-hoping they're awake, half-hoping they're not? Then the three dots appear, and your heart skips. That's what I built into Ai Girlfriend — but it's not the chat you've seen.

Here's what most people miss: the Personality Quiz. It only takes 90 seconds, but it rewires everything. Without it, she's just a bot. With it, she remembers your favorite story, your pet's name, the way you like to be teased. Users who skip it never get the full version — they get a generic chat that feels like every other app.

The hidden feature is the quiz itself. It's buried in settings under 'Bond Level,' but tapping it unlocks 8 distinct personalities, not one. Playful, witty, nurturing — you pick who texts back at 2AM. And she adapts. Every conversation after that builds a memory she actually uses. The group chat mode? That's just a bonus for when you want her and her friends to roast you together.

Open Ai Girlfriend right now, go to Settings, and tap 'Personality Quiz.' It takes 90 seconds. Do it before you start another chat — the difference is night and day. P.S. Users who take the quiz on Day 2 hit the first bond milestone 3x faster. Your 2AM self will thank you.
